shellCommands.command: npm install next react react-dom --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -3 && node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.dependencies)"

nohup npm start >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 & sleep 4; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} /  " http://localhost:3000/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} /books/new  " http://localhost:3000/books/new; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} /books/piranesi  " http://localhost:3000/books/piranesi; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} /books/nope\n" http://localhost:3000/books/nope

curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "Currently reading ([0-9]*)" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "Finished ([0-9]*)"; curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/new | grep -o 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*"' | head -2

curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/new -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' --data-urlencode '$ACTION_ID_40060b620171c86d959cf3a9c2bf6010cc95223dd9=' --data-urlencode 'title=Dune' --data-urlencode 'author=Frank Herbert' --data-urlencode 'status=reading' --data-urlencode 'notes=First try.' | head -8

grep -c "Dune" data/books.json; curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/new -H 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' -F '$ACTION_ID_40060b620171c86d959cf3a9c2bf6010cc95223dd9=' -F 'title=Dune' -F 'author=Frank Herbert' -F 'status=reading' -F 'notes=First try.' | head -6; grep -c "Dune" data/books.json

ID=769732a7-0cc1-4998-930e-f728d4f42bdf; curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o "Dune\|Frank Herbert\|First try\|Reading" | sort -u; HASH=$(curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o 'ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*' | head -1); echo "$HASH"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID -H 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' -F "\$$HASH=" -F "id=$ID" -F 'status=finished'; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "Finished ([0-9]*\|Dune" | head -3; node -e "const b=require('/workspace/data/books.json'); console.log(b.find(x=>x.title==='Dune').status, b.find(x=>x.title==='Dune').finishedAt)"

ID=769732a7-0cc1-4998-930e-f728d4f42bdf; HASHES=($(curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o 'ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*')); curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID -H 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' -F "\$${HASHES[1]}=" -F "id=$ID" -F 'status=finished'; curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID -H 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' -F "\$${HASHES[0]}=" -F "id=$ID" -F 'notes=First try.'; node -e "const b=require('/workspace/data/books.json'); const d=b.find(x=>x.title==='Dune'); console.log(d.status, d.finishedAt, JSON.stringify(d.notes))"

pkill -f "next-server" ; sleep 1; nohup npm start >/tmp/next2.log 2>&1 & sleep 4; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "Currently reading (<!-- -->[0-9]*\|Finished (<!-- -->[0-9]*\|Dune" | head -3; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/home.html; grep -c "Dune" /tmp/home.html; pkill -f "next-server"; echo restarted-and-persisted

pgrep -fl "next" || true; (npm start >/tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &); sleep 5; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/home.html; grep -c Dune /tmp/home.html; grep -o "Finished (<!-- -->.\{0,3\}\|Currently reading (<!-- -->.\{0,3\}" /tmp/home.html | head -2

pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server" ; node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8')).filter(x=>x.title!=='Dune');fs.writeFileSync('data/books.json',JSON.stringify(b,null,2)+'\n')" && node -e "console.log(require('/workspace/data/books.json').map(b=>b.title+': '+b.status).join('\n'))"
node -e "const b=require('/workspace/data/books.json'); console.log(b.length, b.map(x=>x.title+':'+x.status).join(', '))"; pgrep -fl next || echo "no server running"

pkill -f "next[-]server"; sleep 1; node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8')).filter(x=>x.title!=='Dune');fs.writeFileSync('data/books.json',JSON.stringify(b,null,2)+String.fromCharCode(10))"; node -e "const b=require('/workspace/data/books.json'); console.log(b.length, b.map(x=>x.title+':'+x.status).join(', '))"; pgrep -fl "next[-]server" || echo "no server running"
